title: Preserving Cultural Identity with Context-Aware Translation Through Multi-Agent AI Systems
reasoning: The paper includes a significant qualitative evaluation of its translation framework specifically within the context of 'Religion' across different languages. It evaluates the translation of spiritual and ritualistic elements such as the Ganga Aarti (Hinduism), the Whirling Dervishes (Sufism), and Shabbat/Passover (Judaism), focusing on preserving theological precision and spiritual meaning.
